implementation_summary: Fixed all race condition and validation vulnerabilities in MultiSigWallet: (1) Added reentrancy guard (_reentrancyGuard) to prevent reentrant calls during execution. (2) Changed confirmation tracking from simple bool to Confirmation struct with blockNumber for timestamp tracking. (3) Added confirmationBlock field to Transaction struct to snapshot when required confirmations were reached. (4) Implemented getConfirmationCountAtBlock to check confirmations as of specific block number. (5) Added isConfirmedAtBlock function for frontend integration. (6) Updated submitTransaction with zero-address validation and code-size check for contract targets. (7) Enhanced executeTransaction with reentrancy protection, block-level confirmation snapshot, and post-execution revocation check. (8) Created comprehensive test suite with 14 test cases covering reentrancy attacks, confirmation revocation during callback, front-running prevention, zero-address rejection, and gas cost validation.
acceptance_criteria_met: Transaction cannot execute if confirmations are revoked during the execution callback
Block-level confirmation check prevents front-running attacks
Existing multi-sig flows work: submit, confirm, execute, revoke
Gas cost for executeTransaction does not exceed 100,000 gas for a simple ETH transfer
Tests cover: confirmation revocation during callback, front-running revocation, zero-address rejection
